Selling gives p1 the game's first monopoly, but taking cash instead lets me chase the remaining greens and Park Place/Boardwalk. I don't think taking New York instead of cash helps me much since oranges are already split with p3's St James. I'll counter around $550 cash, which would leave p1 too strapped to develop quickly while giving me plenty to pursue other monopolies.
